sections.title: Explanation
sections.content: Hungarian usually marks plural nouns with -k. The form of the noun may change before the suffix.

Notice könyv becomes könyvek, not könyvk — Hungarian needs a linking vowel between a consonant-ending noun and the -k, and which vowel it uses (here -e-) depends on vowel harmony. Learn each noun's plural as a pair rather than assuming you can always just tack -k onto what you already know.
